name: multiplex
description: Coordinate work across agents, models, and providers in one KiroCrew overview. Follow goals, progress, updates, and next actions, then open the conversation to continue.
author: Multiplex contributors
highlights: Bring sessions across agents, models, and providers into one view.
See active work, idle sessions, and requests for your attention.
Capture concise goals, updates, evidence, and next actions on each session.
Use list, cards, or compact grid views for the same operational state.
useCases: Coordinate a mixed team of agents using different models and providers.
Pick up a session from its recorded goal, updates, and next action.
Keep native sessions visible for later review and resumption.
configuration: Install and enable Multiplex from a trusted local checkout or registry.
Optionally install lifecycle hooks for supported native clients.
Use the card editor only for concise corrections, handoffs, or exceptional notes.
